mandate: C403 — test the cross-sectional intraday ASYMCURV: ASYMMETRIC CURVATURE / CONDITIONAL SKEWNESS x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1944 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. ASYMCURV scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t, paired with lagged returns L=r[t-W..t-1]: skew_up[t] = population (ddof=0) skewness of {x in X : l > 0}, skew_down[t] = population skewness of {x in X : l < 0}, asym_curv[t] = skew_up - skew_down. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in window, either conditional sample size < 3, sigma=0, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 3 real (asym_curv_dev, skew_up_dev, skew_down_dev) + 3 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar return window or conditional sample size<3 or sigma=0 or not finite).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t, paired with lagged returns L=r[t-W..t-1]: skew_up=pop skew of {x:l>0}, skew_down=pop skew of {x:l<0}, asym_curv=skew_up-skew_down.
methodology.signals: asym_curv/skew_up/skew_down over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1944 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 6 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.asymcurv_vectorization_note: asymcurv conditional-skewness scalars via sliding_window_view(X,256) + boolean masking of lagged-return sign (l=r[t-W..t-1]) with population (ddof=0) third/second moments; validated against brute-force per-window conditional skewness with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Per-asset metric computation parallelized via ProcessPoolExecutor.
